title: GTA 6 Sales: Est. 19M Copies. Did You Buy It?
caption:
Sensor Tower estimates GTA 6 sold about 19 million copies and $1.84 billion by launch-day morning (digital, pre-orders included). GTA 5 sold 11.21 million in its first 24 hours in 2013. Take-Two hasn't confirmed any number yet.
Did you buy GTA 6 on day one?

Sources: Sensor Tower via Fox 5 NY and Geeks + Gamers; Take-Two (GTA 5, 2013)
ig_first_line: 19 million copies before most people even got home from work. That's the GTA 6 estimate. GTA 5 did 11M.
